| format = ul | template = Salvaged from/result format | link = none | limit = 500 | sort = Has availability, Has canonical name | default = This item is not salvaged from any salvage items.{{#if: {{NAMESPACE}}||[[Category:Pages with empty semantic mediawiki query results]]}} }} == Description == List all items that [[salvage]] into this item in an unordered list. Semantically, queries for the [[Property:Salvages into]] property. If the list is longer than 10 items, the list will be split into two columns. Format using {{tl|Contained in/result format}}. Displays a suffix next to items depending on the [[Property:Has availability]]. 
{{salvaged from|}}
== Parameters == ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' :Required. Item name. Defaults to "PAGENAME". ; columns : Optional. Used to specify the number of columns. == Examples == 
{{salvaged from|Iron Ore}}
{{salvaged from|Iron Ore}} == See also == * {{tl|Salvages into}} [[Category:Item templates]] [[Category:List formatting templates]]
